recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Body: Kyle and Serena Denton are community herbalists creating wild-crafted and organic plant medicines out of Milwaukee since 2015. I have used their teas and tinctures on an almost daily basis for years now. Kyle is a great friend of InnerVerse and has appeared on the channel more times than I can count. These products work, not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.
recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Name: Tippecanoe Herbs
recA5BnM5umys9yRk.Offer Line: Use coupon code "innerverse" at checkout for a 10% discount!

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

recFdBmTf1pJJOP6S.Body: LotusWei provides amazing and transformative plant essence elixirs, using one of nature's most gentle and beautiful elements: the flowers themselves. Led by founder Katie Hess, LotusWei supports customers with diverse products that operate on homeopathic principles and energetic resonances. I use LotusWei Elixirs to give me an edge with psychic & energetic sensitivity, discernment, and life force coherence. In other words, LotusWei Elixirs help me be a better podcaster and Biofield Tuner. Benefits accumulate over long term use!
recFdBmTf1pJJOP6S.Name: LotusWei Flower Elixirs
recFdBmTf1pJJOP6S.Offer Line: Use my affiliate link to support InnerVerse

He has appeared on InnerVerse multiple times to talk about hydrogen as a macronutrient and EZ water.
recIZOksQw0qqj7L0.Name: AquaCure AC50
recIZOksQw0qqj7L0.Offer Line: Use coupon code "innerverse" for a discount

recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.
recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Name: Clive de Carle

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Bio: Gabriel, known on air as Slick Dissident, co-hosts InnerVerse's Vibe Rant show and is a longtime recurring guest on the podcast. He teaches occult symbolism and tarot on his YouTube channel, ranging across the Major Arcana, the esoteric Enneagram, mythology and archetype, mystic linguistics, and the symbolism hidden in popular film. He is best known for Tarot-tories, his own system mapping the 22 Major Arcana and zodiac archetypes onto the geography of the United States.
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Name: Gabe (Slick Dissident)
recBE7KwrPCyVVZMU.Role: Co-host of Vibe Rant; teacher of occult symbolism & tarot

recQOLj1bGHrs7YCW.Bio: Michelle Lundquist describes herself as a folk herbalist, gardener and homemaker with a passion for plants and their ability to heal. She has studied and actively worked with herbs since 2013, drawing most of her knowledge from hands on experience and mentors of the wise woman tradition, and a do it yourself spirit runs through her work as she encourages people to take their wellbeing into their own hands. She hosted more than eighty episodes of The Healing Home podcast as a kitchen witch, homemaker and folk herbalist, and now co-hosts Symbolic Studies with her husband Mario Garza.
recQOLj1bGHrs7YCW.Name: Michelle Lundquist

recikO1LzuvqEbe0G.Bio: James Frosch is the founder of Family Fungi, a holistic wellness homestead providing mushroom-based medicines and DIY mycology wisdom, discussed on InnerVerse alongside topics like enzyme function and endocrine health.
recikO1LzuvqEbe0G.Name: James Frosch

recnfCjixgWatqNdc.Bio: Elise Frosch is a natural-birth educator and "birth keeper" who, with her husband James, runs the homestead business Family Fungi; she appeared on InnerVerse twice discussing preparation for pregnancy, labor, and ecstatic natural birth.
recnfCjixgWatqNdc.Name: Elise Frosch

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Natural Alternatives and the Idea of Side Success", "body": "James of Grounded Extracts said his main aim was to offer alternatives to pharmaceuticals that were not addictive and did not carry side effects. He argued that side effects were simply effects, and that natural remedies used properly produced what he called side success, meaning unanticipated benefits. He stressed that he was not trying to replace anyone or anything, only to have options. Michelle Lundquist said she first came to his work through an earlier interview and praised his perspective, and speakers agreed that small batch remedies carried more potency and the maker's intent."}, {"title": "Inner Herbs, Drop Doses, and Sacred Voice", "body": "A host showed a tincture blend that Kyle, a recent guest, had sent him, made from tulsi, calamus, St. John's wort and Solomon's seal. Michelle Lundquist described the tiny holes in the St. John's wort leaf as gateways for light and for working through trauma. Several speakers argued that a single drop could act more on an emotional level than a full dropper, and Gabe said he believed some goddesses preferred purity over quantity. A speaker noted that the Sanskrit vacha and Latin vox both mean voice, and James tied the idea to the inner voice."}, {"title": "Addiction Consultations and Self Compassion", "body": "James said the main work at Grounded Extracts at the time was addiction consultations, which he described as blunt, question based and not something anyone should jump into. He asked listeners not to reach out on behalf of others, since people who were not seeking help were not ready. One speaker argued that self condemnation held back change and that anyone still breathing was not damned. Speakers also stressed that a person's relationship to a plant such as cannabis mattered a great deal, and that respect for it mattered most."}, {"title": "Catharsis, Dream Witnessing, and Plant Meditation", "body": "Gabe reflected that people will go out of their way for a sense of catharsis and wondered whether the word had a phonetic link to the Cathars. Later, Chance wondered whether dreaming could let a person serve as a witness or guide for another being. Michelle Lundquist told of a dream in which she delivered a letter for a woman who lacked the courage to send it. Another speaker described meditating with plants by entering an inner sanctuary and asking permission to enter the herb, and a speaker stressed that nobody was recommending any substance."}, {"title": "Gatekeepers, Middlemen, and Doing the Work", "body": "Chance argued that commerce, health care and spiritual middlemen all profited from standing between people and their source, and that the deepest gate of all was the fear of knowing ourselves. A speaker said that growing your own food and making your own medicine were steps toward opening that gate. Another speaker used a ladder image, saying any modality could become the new pattern that held a person until they stepped off it. Later, another guest introduced German New Medicine, the idea that ailments were tied to trauma, and speakers traded simple breathing and reflexology tricks."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: James from Grounded Extracts joins Vibe Rant tonight to talk about his life and work, assisting those who are ready to leave allopathy behind and step into the freedom of true health. Topics may include addiction and iboga, natural birth, and spagyric alchemy, but with Vibe Rant, everything is on the table!
